pattern.description: The glob to match file paths against, such as *.go (a file name at any depth) or **/*.test.ts. A pattern with a slash is matched against the whole path, relative to the workspace root or absolute in a read-only root, so start it with **/ to match below the path you give.

path.description: The directory to search; the workspace root by default. It may also be a read-only root such as a Go module directory.
